completeness.why: copyPreviousMonth and setZero call isCategoryFilled with an explicit kind, the three averages take their category set from getAverageFillCategories (whose SQL no longer filters hidden rows; the hidden and income rules are decided by isCategoryFilled 'average'), and both sign inversions go through averageToBudgetAmount; the setZero and missing-group inconsistencies are carried by the kind argument and the un-awaited writes stay as site-local data handling.

interface.why: One selection function with a kind parameter that makes the preserved inconsistencies explicit (zero writes hidden, copy keeps NULL groups, average drops them) and a small sign helper; no speculative options, though the kind values name the callers ('copy'/'zero'/'average') rather than the hidden-category rule they select, and getAverageFillCategories types its rows as DbViewCategory while selecting group_hidden.

disguised_duplication.where: The income/hidden checks and the three copied average queries are removed in favour of isCategoryFilled, getAverageFillCategories and averageToBudgetAmount in server/budget/actions.ts; no copy remains in reshaped form.
